name: NitroStack
description: Builds, tests and deploys MCP servers in TypeScript with a decorator-based framework, a scaffolding CLI, a desktop testing studio, and NitroCloud hosting.

skills.name: Project Scaffolding
skills.description: Creates a new MCP server project from one of five official templates, including starter, OAuth 2.1, and enterprise search.

skills.name: Code Generation
skills.description: Generates modules, tools, types, guards and health checks for an existing NitroStack project from the command line.

skills.name: Hot-Reload Dev Server
skills.description: Runs the MCP server in development mode with automatic reloading, ready to open in NitroStudio for visual testing.

skills.name: Cursor Integration
skills.description: Registers the MCP server with Cursor IDE over command, legacy SSE, or streamable HTTP transport with one CLI command.

skills.name: Git-Push Deploys
skills.description: Deploys an MCP server to NitroCloud from GitHub, the CLI, or a ZIP, with scale-to-zero compute and custom domains.
